description: Official-source program navigation. These are avenues to check, not eligibility or funding approvals.

records.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: senior citizen pathway
records.summary: NHA describes an age-70-and-over enrollment pathway. Confirm enrollment, participating state/facility, package and preauthorization before care.

records.name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
records.summary: Government assistance route for poor patients with specified life-threatening diseases treated in government hospitals. Ask the hospital social-work desk about current criteria, documents and sanction; this source describes the program, not current individual approval.

records.name: Health Minister's Discretionary Grant
records.summary: MoHFW publishes an application route for financial assistance. Current income rules, hospital requirements and approval must be checked with the administering authority.

records.name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK): sick infants
records.summary: NHM describes treatment, diagnostics, medicines and transport entitlements for sick infants up to one year at government facilities. Confirm the child's exact age and local pathway; integer age alone is not an eligibility decision.

records.name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
records.summary: An affordable generic-medicine access program, not hospital insurance. Check local medicine availability and ask the prescribing clinician or pharmacist about the prescribed formulation.

records.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
records.summary: Maharashtra's health scheme provides an official hospital and procedure lookup. Confirm beneficiary eligibility, current package acceptance and the exact empanelled branch with the scheme desk.
